releaseNotes: Fixed: Usenet (NZB) results now show for Premiumize and TorBox users (they were cut off behind the first 100 torrent rows) and no longer fill with par2, rar-part and soundtrack files. Fixed: the Choose stream list shows clean titles and trailer names, and a Premiumize Needs attention notice clears after pairing again. New: HappyFappy share ratio shown in Test the login.
